text:
Predicates:
Occurs(x, y) ::: x occurs in y.
Gets(y, x) ::: y gets x.
Virus(x) ::: x is a virus.
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
Human(x) ::: x is a human.
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
Symptom(x, y) ::: x is a symptom of y.
FeelsTired(x) ::: x feels tired.
Flu(x) ::: x is the flu.
Premises:
∀y (Occurs(monkeypoxVirus, y) → Gets(y, monkeypox)) ::: When the Monkeypox virus occurs in a being, it may get Monkeypox.
∃x (Animal(x) ∧ Occurs(monkeypoxVirus, x)) ::: Monkeypox virus can occur in certain animals.
∀x (Human(x) → Mammal(x)) ::: Humans are mammals.
∀x (Mammal(x) → Animal(x)) ::: Mammals are animals.
Symptom(fever, monkeypox) ∧ Symptom(headache, monkeypox) ∧ Symptom(musclePains, monkeypox) ∧ Symptom(tiredness, monkeypox) ::: Symptoms of Monkeypox include fever, headache, muscle pains, and tiredness.
∀x (Gets(x, flu) → FeelsTired(x)) ::: People feel tired when they get the flu.
Conclusion:
¬∃x Gets(x, flu) ::: No one gets the flu.
